clue.text: Censor, after Trump's opening "get knotted!" – "a rash action on his part"

explanation.surface: A newspaper sneers at a censorious Trump, quoting a rude dismissal and calling his move rash.

explanation.definitionFit: Trump's early executive order barring arrivals from several mainly Muslim countries was widely condemned as hasty and ill-judged.
